# RE:volution Mod v1.4.6

## Mob Balance

This release adds the runtime Mob Balance layer on top of the existing Balance Core while preserving the current configured gameplay baseline.

Canonical stage mobs named `Mob<locationId>_<mobSlotId>` can now resolve optional active-balance overrides for:

- `hp`
- reward `resource`
- reward `amount`

Each field falls back independently to the existing persisted mob definition when no balance override is present. The bundled v1.4.6 balance therefore does not invent or replace current production HP/reward values.

## Compatibility and boundaries

- Non-canonical/legacy mob names remain persistence-driven.
- Mongo writes and schema are unchanged.
- Mob identity, type, models, textures, spawn coordinates, population, movement mode, zones, stage geometry and world topology remain outside Mob Balance.
- Mob Balance uses the same active `BalanceService` snapshot as rune systems.
- Invalid non-positive HP/reward values and unknown reward resource ids are rejected.
- Existing physical mob lives are not rewritten mid-life.

## Verification

A dedicated Mob Balance regression covers baseline fallback behavior, canonical and partial overrides, legacy mobs, the integer reward bridge, and invalid-data handling. Architecture guards also keep repository packages ports-only by locating the balance-aware decorator in the service layer.

Admin Balance Preview/Apply remains scheduled for v1.4.7. Population tuning, visual changes, boss topology changes, and real-value rebalance are not part of v1.4.6.
